description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Universities in Sri Lanka and Foreign Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to enter into Memoranda of Understanding/Agreements between Universities in Sri Lanka and Foreign Universities/University Organizations as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.

The Project Agreement between the Alliance of National and International Science Organizations for the Belt and Road Regions and the University of Peradeniya in relation to holding the International Water Conference on Climate Change and Environmental Pollution.
The Research Collaboration Agreement and the Material Transfer Agreement between the University of Peradeniya and the Chinese University of Hong Kong of China with the objective of studying the transmission of Methicillin Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus disease among human and animal populations as well as in the environment, clarifying their antimicrobial resistance and examining genetic diversity.
The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Kelaniya and the Kyoto College of Graduate Studies for Information of Japan for achieving the objectives of enhancing academic cooperation, strengthening friendship between faculties and students through educational, professional and cultural activities and conducting joint research, conferences and seminars.
The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Vavuniya and the Indian Institute of Technology Madras, India for achieving the objectives of establishing academic and research collaboration in mutually agreed upon sectors, exchanging academic information and materials, exchanging of students and academic staff and supporting joint conferences and workshops.
The Memorandum of Understanding between the Indian Council for Cultural Relations and the University of Vavuniya for obtaining the service of visiting professors on contractual basis.
